dedupe_keys.name: building material price data for predictive cost estimation ilorin nigeria zenodo data in brief

description: A dataset of building material prices in Nigeria described in a 2025 Data in Brief article by researchers at Landmark University and Walter Sisulu University. It holds 381 product price records for 2021 to 2024 in Ilorin, Kwara State, with product description, unit, supplier minimum and maximum price and yearly average price in Nigerian naira, covering tanks, pressure pipes, wastewater pipes, fittings and similar items. Prices come from a survey of suppliers and artisans checked against online marketplaces, blogs and industry reports, and were used in the authors' BuildCES system with an LSTM price model. Coverage: one city, so regional price differences are not captured. Format and access: one XLSX file of about 28 kB on Zenodo, free under CC BY 4.0, with raw and processed CSV mentioned in the article. Caveats: the sample is small and product selection reflects local procurement, and the article lists real-time updates as future work. Useful for construction cost estimation, procurement planning and scenario analysis of material price risk in building supply chains; related records are not yet linked.
